Kuwait.exact_reviewed_text: The Kuwait National Framework for Digital Accessibility hosted by PADA explicitly calls for EN 301 549 in ICT procurement, including supplier declarations of conformity. The posted text leaves the effective date as a placeholder tied to signing as bylaws, so it does not by itself establish that those requirements are in force.

Saudi Arabia.exact_reviewed_text: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority’s digital-accessibility policy states that the authority commits to compliance with EN 301 549, alongside other accessibility standards. Saudi Arabia.literal_rendering: The Authority commits to compliance with.
